newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab woman stabs Israeli in Gaza - settlers.
newsitem.headline: Arab woman stabs Israeli in Gaza - settlers.

text.p: A Palestinian woman stabbed an Israeli border policeman on Tuesday near a Jewish settlement in the Gaza Strip, a settler spokeswoman said.
The soldier was moderately wounded in the incident near the Netzarim settlement. The army said it was checking the report.
Israel Radio said another border policeman tried to detain the assailant but Palestinian police cocked their weapons and the woman fled.
Israel handed over parts of Gaza to Palestinian rule in 1994 but some troops remained in the Strip to safeguard Jewish settlements and patrol main roads.
